dynamic_obstacle.scenario: Scripted kinematic cart crossing both front aisles
dynamic_obstacle.navigation_inputs: Existing PhysX ray ranges only; fixture pose/clock/identity are evaluation-only
dynamic_obstacle.scope: Dynamic navigation exposure only; full success also requires original robot, route and home guards

measurement_projection.projected_trace_fields: Both dogs every200Hz native step; root state, phases, original jaw forces, payload state. Arm/leg action matrices and camera/range raw arrays omitted.

limitations: Original-mass Z1 two-dog unloaded dynamic-cart navigation; scripted kinematic obstacle, PhysX ranging, simulation localization. Not cargo delivery, SLAM or learned obstacle motion.
